action_items: Deviation from spec: PolicyWizard/CreditPolicy treat credit_manager as isAdmin. The review request says 'New policy (Wizard) button on /credit-policy, admin only' and 'Non-admin sees activate disabled'. Currently a credit_manager can both open the wizard and click wiz-activate (backend also allows because ROLE_PERMS grants credit_manager 'policy_edit'). If spec strictly requires admin-only, change isAdmin in /app/frontend/src/pages/CreditPolicy.js and /app/frontend/src/pages/PolicyWizard.js to check only 'admin', and remove 'policy_edit' from credit_manager in server.py ROLE_PERMS. Otherwise update the spec to reflect the manager+admin behavior.

OPTIONAL: The committee-bar renders even when application is already 'approved'/'rejected' — clicking Approve on an already-approved app still succeeds and re-writes audit. Consider disabling/hiding actions that don't apply once the application has reached a terminal state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1359 lines — RBAC additions further increase surface area; still recommend splitting into auth/applications/credit_brain/credit_policy/rbac modules.

authority_for_amount() sorts by 'max' and returns the first slab whose max >= amount. Because analyst.max (10L) < manager.max (50L) < admin.max (1e9), the admin slab ordering is fine, but if the wizard/UI writes an approval_authority list with overlapping ranges or missing admin slab the function silently falls back to 'Senior Credit / Admin' string — consider validating the slab list on PUT to guarantee it covers 0..+inf without gaps.

POST /applications/{id}/action does not require a decision for reject/escalate/send_review — only approve does. That's per current design, but escalating a pending app (no decision yet) writes no 'amount' field into the audit. Confirm intended.

Frontend committee-bar in ApplicationDetail shows the bar whenever perms include approve OR review — for a decision that already reached 'approved' or 'rejected', the actions remain enabled. Consider gating on application.status not being terminal.
CreditPolicy.js and PolicyWizard.js define isAdmin = ['admin','credit_manager'] — mismatch with the review request wording that says admin-only. See action_items.
